metadata.publisher: Gleislicht, derived from SBB, Luzern, FOT and OpenStreetMap data
metadata.dayModel: civil day with preceding service-day spillover
metadata.label: Luzern canton — admitted complete stop patterns
metadata.model: scheduled interpolation along official rail, cableway and cartographic shipping alignments, with inferred OSM bus roads
metadata.note: Complete directed stop patterns only; retain every original source call. Cantonal geometry takes precedence. Missing geometry may use full-pattern OSM bus, federal rail, reviewed SBB border curves or explicitly bound federal cableway installations. Boat geometry uses generalized swissTLMRegio shipping curves only when every directed pair passes bounded dock attachments and full shoreline-intersection checks. Every source, identity, connectivity and distance check must pass. Paths are inferred, not observed vehicles, certified running tracks or navigational shipping lanes.
metadata.scope: Every annual GTFS trip with at least one source stop inside the complete official Luzern polygon, across every agency and mode. Fixture trips retain every source call, including cross-canton termini. No straight-line crossing test for nonstopping through traffic.
exclusions: Annual GTFS membership is a census of the pinned archive, not proof that all real-world or demand-responsive services are represented.
Fixture validation covers Friday and Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in, not all annual seasonal, holiday or diversion patterns.
Services crossing the canton without a stop are outside the passenger-service scope.
No realtime data, one-way street certification or individual running-track validation.
Shipping uses generalized source curves and a 2007 shoreline with explicitly recorded dock-area discrepancies; no current navigability or operator-certified sailing lane is established.

All original calls and timestamps remain. Como schematics are retained as rejected source evidence.

shipping.attribution: Shipping geometry: © swisstopo; shoreline validation: © FOEN, swisstopo
shipping.featureSourceDates: Not supplied by the shipping API; collection dates do not establish individual feature vintage.
shipping.acquisition: Fourteen adjoining bounded shipping queries cover the full dock areas: twelve for Lake Lucerne and two for Hallwilersee. Every response is below the 200 feature cap and shared features must agree byte-for-byte. One full lake query retains all polygon parts and holes. This is a scoped regional source census, not a national shipping census.
shipping.model: Gleislicht cartographic inference on generalized official passenger-shipping linework, with source-vertex connectivity, explicit GTFS dock attachments and full shoreline-intersection checks. Not navigational, operator-certified shipping lanes or current-diversion evidence.

files.description: Acquisition receipts and source query envelopes

shipping.shorelineRule: Split each path edge at all original shoreline and island-ring intersections. An outside-water interval is retained only wholly within 150 m of one actual endpoint dock, and its full evidence is disclosed. Any remote land crossing excludes the whole pattern. Source and shoreline vintages do not establish current navigability.
shipping.pathAttribution: geometrySources = swisstopo-boat-inference; full source curves with bounded original-dock attachments and disclosed shoreline discrepancies

accessRoadFallback.description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02; bus graph with service roads and strict stop candidates
accessRoadFallback.filtering: pfaedle -X type/tag filter using retained filter.cfg and filter-patterns.json. The national filtered graph is retained, not claimed to be spatially clipped. Matching covers the complete three-route fixture scope; no border supplement required. Filter profile adds highway=service; original access, turn and road-class rules remain.
accessRoadFallback.routing: Retained routing.cfg adds highway=service to the keep list and tightens bus OSM station-candidate and edge-snap distances to 20 m. Original road-access/turn penalties retained; no official bus-access certification.
accessRoadFallback.qualification: Inferred bus corridors, including explicit short GTFS-platform attachments. Not operator-verified directions or temporary diversions.
